verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a REST API that covers projects, experiments, datasets, logs, prompts and scorers, but nothing in the evidence mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 for all of them. The axis applies to an API platform, so the lack of a documented spec yields none.
